_readme: Durable, scrape-proof enrichment for members whose public GrowthZone listing is too thin for search. The weekly member scraper OVERWRITES members.json, so any hand-edit to a member's categories/description is lost on the next run (this is what kept un-fixing Medwick). Instead, put the enrichment here — scripts/scrape-members.mjs and scripts/apply-member-overrides.mjs re-apply it after every scrape, and the Upstash search index (sync-vectors) reads the enriched members.json. Keyed by chamberSlug. addCategories are merged (deduped) onto the scraped categories; description replaces an empty/thin scraped one. Update the vector index after changing this: `node scripts/apply-member-overrides.mjs && node scripts/sync-vectors-to-upstash.mjs`.

medwick-construction.note: Community Investor. GrowthZone lists them only as a general contractor, but roofing and insurance restoration are core services — without this they never surface for 'roofing'/'roofers'.
medwick-construction.description: Medina County's insurance restoration advocate. Medwick Construction specializes in roofing, storm, wind, and hail damage repair, water mitigation, and full-property reconstruction — working directly with homeowners and their insurers to restore homes and businesses after fire, water, and storm damage. A licensed general contractor, not a public adjuster.

Text below is their copy verbatim with only those defects repaired. Real fix belongs in the GrowthZone profile.
centerra-fka-town-country-co-op-medina.description: Formerly Town & Country, Centerra Co-Op is rooted in the agricultural and rural communities we serve. We understand the investment our customers have in their operations and work hard with them shoulder to shoulder to give them the confidence they need to grow and sustain the lifestyles they desire. We are 350 associates working together, brainstorming ideas, seeking input, trusting each other's skills and genuinely enjoying what we do. We extend that spirit to our customers. At Centerra, we offer Farm products and agronomy services to small-, mid- and large growers; Grain storage and merchandising; Feed for beef and dairy producers; Energy products to residential, farm and commercial customers; Pet, farm and bird feed sold through our Country Stores and much more! Centerra's Country Store in Medina offers a wide selection of pet and farm animal products, including feed, treats, supplements, healthcare items, toys, grooming and show accessories. We also carry lawn, garden and pond supplies, our own Sommer's Wild Bird feed, birdfeeders, home and garden décor and we refill propane tanks. Shop inside or in our convenient drive-through where our friendly and knowledgeable associates will help you choose the right products and load them into your vehicle. In Medina, you'll also find a Centerra fueling station at 901 W. Smith Rd., offering gasoline, on- and off-road diesel, DEF, Rec-90 and more. Need us to come to you? No problem! Centerra offers delivery of bulk feed, fuel and propane. Visit us at www.centerracoop.com or call 419-281-8423 to learn more.

dominique-moceanu-gymnastics-center.description: Welcome to Dominique Moceanu Gymnastics Center! This is the home of the youngest Olympic champion in U.S. gymnastics history, Dominique Moceanu. Dominique wanted to build upon her championship legacy for her family, children and community by opening a state-of-the-art gymnastics facility. After years of passionately advocating nationwide for a safer gymnastics environment, free from abuse, Dominique has overseen every detail of the new gym with a focus on athlete health and safety and a joyful celebration of the sport! The Dominique Moceanu Gymnastics Center is designed to be a place where every family member can also enjoy activities ranging from instructional gymnastics and gymnastics camps to yoga! The Center's motto is: Peace. Strength. Balance. Join us for fun, rewarding and positive experiences!!
